still_open.problem: This gap predates the fix-6 round. The differential test only samples ASCII plus three other code points (é, U+0085, U+2028). No other test puts a non-ASCII code point outside a quoted span, so a class change involving any other non-ASCII code point passes all 27 tests. In the battery, 68 real mutants survived: (1) 54 that add one of U+00A0, U+1680, U+2002, U+202F, U+3000, U+FEFF, U+200B, U+4E2D or U+1F600 to the program's first or rest class, _SAFE, the separator, or either pad; (2) 13 that refuse one of those nine code points, or a range (U+0100-U+2027, the zero-width characters, the surrogates, the astral planes), inside a quoted span; (3) one that compiles the gate with re.I, which lets 'vsdd survey ſ' (U+017F), 'vsdd survey K' (U+212A) and 'vsdd survey aİb' (U+0130) through both gates. The current regex is right on every code point: a sweep of all 1,113,984 code points from U+0080 at nine positions found no disagreement. The risk is low. The shells and the parser treat non-ASCII characters as word characters, so a widened blank class is refused by the parsed gate wherever it would change the program. A narrowed quoted span fails safe, but it would stop marking real calls that quote an emoji or CJK title.
still_open.proposed_fix: Change test_caller.py only. Add a test that checks every code point c from U+0080 to U+10FFFF with _CALL_TEXT_RE alone. c must be refused in each of these texts: '<c>x/vsdd survey', './a<c>b/vsdd survey', 'vsdd survey a<c>b', "vsdd survey a<c>='x'", 'vsdd<c>survey', '<c>vsdd survey', 'vsdd survey<c>' and "vsdd survey 'x'<c>". One text holding every such code point inside a single quoted span must be accepted. Also send U+017F, U+212A, U+0130 and U+0131 in a bare word through is_vsdd_call and assert refusal, which catches a case-insensitive gate. A scratch version of this test adds about 4.6 s, passes on the current code and kills all 68 survivors. If that is too slow, extend DIFFERENTIAL_CHARACTERS instead, with one code point per Unicode general category, every Zs, Zl, Zp and Cf code point, a surrogate, an astral code point and the four case-folding letters, then re-run the non-ASCII mutants.
